notes.title: Hotfix
notes.content: [p]Hello! This is the first update to the game based on the first round of feedback. [/p][p]Besides the fixes mentioned below, this update also contains numerous minor bug fixes. [/p][p][/p][h2]Vehicle Physics[/h2][list][*][p]Pac, Velocity R and Trekker now have reduced understeer. [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Maps [/h2][list][*][p]Canyon: fixed some fences automatically breaking on player spawn[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Settings Menu[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed graphics settings showing up blank on initial launch of settings menu,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed resolution settings causing window type to change. [/p][/*][/list]
